description.value: Outpost is a multi-brand community space in Port Moody that gathers Timbertrain Coffee Roasters, Superflux Beer, Field House Brewing, and several other local craft breweries under one commercial roof. The venue positions itself as neither a coffee shop nor a brewery but a community hub, serving espresso drinks and café food from 8am alongside craft beer on tap. A touring cyclist will find a full breakfast-and-lunch menu — paninis, wraps, sandwiches — plus cocktails and rotating local draught beer in a single stop.

address.value: 3001 Saint Johns Street, Port Moody, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at outpost.ca was successfully fetched and confirms the business is a real, active community space at 3001 Saint Johns Street, Port Moody, BC — operating daily. However, the OSM record lists the community as 'North Vancouver,' which contradicts the website's explicit 'Port Moody' location; the coordinates (49.28, -122.85) also place the site in Port Moody, not North Vancouver. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the website, but the menu explicitly labels a 'Vegan Rye Cookie,' confirming at least one vegan item, and the phrase 'coffee for your morning commute' strongly implies takeout service.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business website explicitly states Port Moody, BC, and the coordinates (49.28, -122.85) confirm a Port Moody location — the OSM community tag appears to be incorrect.
No phone number is listed in OSM or on the website.
OSM addr:street is 'Saint Johns Street' — website spells it the same way, consistent.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café and community space with a confirmed website, full food and drink menu, and daily operating hours — a useful stop for touring cyclists.
enrichment_extras.notes: Outpost is a Marcon Developments branded hospitality concept. The email hello@outpost.ca is listed on the website footer. The OSM tag bar=yes is consistent with the website showing craft beer and cocktails on the menu.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu explicitly lists 'Vegan Rye Cookie' labeled as vegan; multiple other vegetarian-compatible items visible (Outpost Cheese Toastie, Blueberry Granola Yogurt, Spinach Puff, etc.)
